summary: Uniformly scale CAM geometry by factor or longest-side millimeters in Transform and WebMCP, with an explicit origin and bounds.
warning: Scaling changes the selected draft's physical geometry. Manual leads require review and manual initial wire stays fixed and requires review. Stops retain millimeter distances; invalid stops or tolerance-induced topology changes reject the edit. Existing saved revisions and installed posts are never rewritten.

checklist.schema: No UPID, project, saved revision, package or post schema changes. Adds scale to the typed agent edit union.
checklist.events: No execution-event changes. Scaling uses the existing atomic undoable draft edit and explicit save workflow.
checklist.capabilities: No machine or post capability changes. Positive uniform factors preserve exact circles/arcs, nesting and source ownership.
checklist.auditAndOutput: Output and audit rules are unchanged for unchanged jobs. Scaled drafts require normal machining review and machine-fit validation before output.
checklist.installationAndStorage: Browser and folder saves use existing shared project operations. No installed posts, packages, originals or saved revisions are migrated, deleted or rewritten.
checklist.verification: 151 focused geometry/edit/discovery/UI tests pass, including analytic circles/arcs, nesting, explicit origin, longest-side bounds, fixed wire and transformed lead review, preserved stop distances, invalid shrinkage, topology changes and batch atomicity. Native TypeScript typecheck, zero-finding lint and UI ownership check pass. Physical machine verification is not established.

changes: Scale uniformly by factor or fit the longest side, with explicit origin and resulting bounds.
